clauses.reason: This clause declares a national emergency to deal with the threat described in the order's findings. Executive Order 13726 (signed April 19, 2016; its text states no separate effective date) expanded the scope of the national emergency declared in this order, finding that violence in Libya and related acts constitute a further threat; it adds blocking criteria in its own text and does not amend the wording of Executive Order 13566, so this clause continues as written together with the expansion. The clause depends on the national emergency with respect to Libya declared in the lead clause of Executive Order 13566 on February 25, 2011 and expanded on April 19, 2016, whose continuation is stated in the Notice of February 13, 2026 (91 FR 7801; FR Doc. 2026-03279), which states that the emergency must continue in effect beyond February 25, 2026; the next anniversary falls after the cutoff of 2026-10-14, so the emergency and this clause were in effect on that date. The held original contains no own-terms end, expiry or sunset for this clause.
